text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Marquesa - (built 1977) 71,831 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.75 million.
Clarisse Venture - (built 1982) 60,190 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $9 million basis special survey passed.
Oriental Pearl - (built 1976) 20,765 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $2.5 million.
Oriental Conqueror - (built 1977) 17,630 dwt sold to undisclosed buyers for $2.6 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they maybe subject to inspection, survey or other conditions before completion.
